2023-4770-4785-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4687-4929-6006.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
4687-4929-6006.description:
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

710-6495-7424.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
710-6495-7424.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3413-4875-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

570-4644-7791.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {R}{G}{W}{U}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Faeburrow Elder.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.

1368-5223-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5223-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

618-4456-7494-7753.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Valeria Richards.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

4659-5086-5183-6753-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-5086-5183-6753-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

4222-4474-7734.description:
Activate Wakandan Tusker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

3259-5734-7297.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
3259-5734-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

5282-7149-7193.description:
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Omni-Changeling into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Omni-Changeling dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Omni-Changeling enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Omni-Changeling leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Omni-Changeling from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-2292-5987.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

539-5414-7035.description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

283-560-2757-2775.description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Slimefoot's ability.
Resolve both Slimefoot abilities, creating four creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 4 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1315-3234-3293-4050.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1315-3234-3293-4050.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
1315-3234-3293-4050.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4067-4477-6281-6893.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
4067-4477-6281-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty {U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Greenwarden of Murasa.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.

4050-4533-4807-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control less than three Blood tokens.
4050-4533-4807-6753.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Falkenrath Forebear, adding {B}.
When Falkenrath Forebear dies, Voldaren Bloodcaster triggers, creating two Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Falkenrath Forebear by paying {B} and sacrificing the Blood tokens, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2634-4036-4973-5195.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Seething Song.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

requires.n: Creature That Can Be Cast for {2}

678-6518--104.description:
Cast the creature from your hand by paying {0}.
When the creature enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying the creature and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-3372-5223-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2034-3372-5223-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

1263-2018-2292-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Bloodsoaked Champion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities from steps 1 and 5, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-1662.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {1}{W}
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Karoo.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Karoo.
Repeat.
74-943-1662.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Karoo instead.

575-3967-5971.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
575-3967-5971.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When the creature enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

500-4036-4867.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instand and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, returning Seething Song and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
If you have seven or more cards in your graveyard, this combo nets infinite mana.

3384-3815-4067.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four other artifacts.
You control a mana-producing permanent that can produce at least {U}.
3384-3815-4067.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Tamiyo's Logbook by paying {U} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping Tamiyo's Logbook and the mana producing permanent.
Repeat.
